clue.text: Girl briefly also called when touring state

indicators.note: touring means going round, so one piece travels round the other

parts.note: AKA is the abbreviation for 'also known as', i.e. also called

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the final letter of the girl is lost

parts.note: a lass is a girl, especially in northern Britain

explanation.surface: A girl's nickname is used as she travels around one of the states.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' shortens the girl, and 'touring' sends AKA around her; 'touring' looks like travel but signals one piece enclosing another.
explanation.definitionFit: Alaska is the largest US state, so it is an example of a state.

clue.text: Luscious oranges and melons primarily growing in this?

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so the opening letter of each word is taken

explanation.surface: A greengrocer's question about the soil that juicy oranges and melons grow in.
explanation.definitionFit: Loam is rich crumbly soil, a medium in which fruit plants are grown.

clue.text: Player who's fancied fruit left item in ring?

parts.note: in tennis a seed is a player ranked as likely to do well
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: A favoured tennis player leaves some fruit behind.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a ring here is jewellery: a seed pearl is a tiny pearl that may be set in one.
explanation.definitionFit: Seed pearls are very small pearls used as settings in rings and other jewellery.

clue.text: Cowboy or ranger's helping on way up ravine

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means the letters are read from bottom to top, backwards
a helping is a portion, so a portion of these words supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A cowboy or ranger gives a hand on the climb up a ravine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'helping' takes OYORRA from cowbOY OR RAnger's, and 'on way up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An arroyo is a steep-sided dry gully in the American Southwest, a type of ravine.

clue.text: French city cut employment for another one

indicators.note: cut means shortened, so the last letter of the city's name goes

parts.note: Toulon is a naval port city in southern France
employment is use, as in putting a thing to use

explanation.surface: One French city slashes jobs, which go to another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' trims TOULON to TOULO. 'another one' refers back to 'French city', so the definition borrows from the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Toulouse is a large city in southwest France, so it is another French city.

clue.text: Fine old athlete ruined with heroin? It's how things are

indicators.note: something ruined is wrecked, so these letters are smashed and rebuilt

parts.note: H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A once-great sportsman has been wrecked by heroin, and that's the way it is.
explanation.definitionFit: The lie of the land is an idiom for the current state of affairs.

clue.text: Posts at university linked to entitlements

parts.note: being up means being in residence at a university
rights are things one is entitled to

explanation.surface: Jobs at a university are tied to the perks that come with them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Posts' looks like jobs; here it is upright poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Uprights are vertical supports such as goalposts or fence posts.

clue.text: Tyrone town evicts German with a place in Nebraska

indicators.note: evicts means throws out, so one letter is put out of the town

parts.note: Omagh is the county town of Tyrone in Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A Northern Irish town expels a German, sending him off to the American Midwest.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in the US state of Nebraska.

clue.text: Georgian perhaps runs three trips round Ohio

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the scrambled letters go round the state
trips means stumbles, so the letters fall into a new order

parts.note: O is the state abbreviation for Ohio

explanation.surface: A man from Georgia makes three journeys around Ohio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trips' rearranges RUNS THREE into SUTHERNER, and 'round' puts it around O.
explanation.definitionFit: Georgia is a US state in the South, so someone from there is an example of a southerner.

clue.text: Story about a stink over North American water

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the story wraps around the rest

parts.note: a lie is a made-up story

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word is written backwards

parts.note: a reek is a stink

explanation.surface: A tale of a bad smell hanging over a lake in North America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns the stink back to front, giving KEER, and 'about' wraps the story around A and those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Erie is one of the Great Lakes, a body of fresh water on the US-Canada border.

clue.text: Troops set back a party sign blocking way

indicators.note: set back means put in reverse, so the letters run the other way

parts.note: OR stands for other ranks, i.e. troops who are not officers
the DUP is the Democratic Unionist Party of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: Soldiers retreat when a political party puts up a sign that blocks the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set back' turns OR into RO. In the UK, a 'Road Up' sign warns of roadworks.
explanation.definitionFit: A Road Up sign marks a road dug up for works and closed to traffic.

clue.text: His happy orgy disrupted study of 5 down

indicators.note: disrupted means thrown into disorder, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's joyous orgy was broken up.
explanation.walkthrough: 5 down is THE LIE OF THE LAND.
explanation.definitionFit: Physiography is physical geography, the science of landforms and how the land lies.

clue.text: Dictionary entry that's clearer when higher

definitions.meaning: the meaning given for a word in a dictionary
the sharpness of an image or screen

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry that becomes easier to understand when it is pitched higher.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition means both a word's stated meaning and an image's sharpness, as in high-definition television.

clue.text: Occasionally meet star climbing this?

indicators.note: occasionally means now and then, so only every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: Now and then you might meet a film star on a climb.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesa is a flat-topped hill with steep sides, the sort of thing a climber scales.

clue.text: Isolated younger rocks form our islet

indicators.note: to form is to shape, so these letters are shaped into a new word

explanation.surface: Some young rocks, cut off from the rest, make up our little island.
explanation.definitionFit: In geology outliers are patches of younger rock surrounded by older strata, cut off by erosion.

clue.text: Decorator houses deer for Reykjavik resident

indicators.note: houses means holds inside, so the second piece sits within the first

parts.note: an icer decorates cakes with icing
an eland is a large African antelope, standing in for deer here

explanation.surface: A painter puts up a deer for a man from Iceland's capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decorator' suggests a house painter, but it is someone who ices cakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Reykjavik is the capital of Iceland, so a resident there is an Icelander.

clue.text: School hung maps showing growth in bogs

indicators.note: to school is to train or discipline, so the letters are drilled into a new order

explanation.surface: A school puts up maps showing the plants that grow in marshes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'School' looks like a noun, but it is a verb meaning train, signalling the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Sphagnum is bog moss, the plant that grows in wet peat bogs.

clue.text: Posh tablet rejected in reading Little Women here?

indicators.note: in means placed within, so the reversed piece goes inside

parts.note: LIT is short for literature, what one reads

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: U means upper-class, posh
a pill is a tablet

explanation.surface: A grand pill is turned down while someone reads the novel Little Women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' makes LLIPU from U and PILL. 'Little Women' looks like the novel, but means tiny women.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilliput is the land of tiny people in Swift's Gulliver's Travels, where little women would live.

clue.text: Adversaries at table abandon country garden

indicators.note: abandon means leave, so these letters walk out of the word

parts.note: Sweden is a country
at a bridge table South and West are opposing players

explanation.surface: Opponents at a card game leave the countryside for a garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Eden is the biblical garden where Adam and Eve lived.

clue.text: Large rock formerly down under 26

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing
Ayers Rock is the old name of Uluru in Australia

explanation.surface: A big Australian rock that used to sit beneath something.
explanation.definitionFit: Strata are layers, as of rock or of society, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Ford a channel going west, following new range

parts.note: the Sierra was a Ford car model

indicators.note: in an across clue going west means reading right to left, backwards

parts.note: Dave is a British TV channel

explanation.surface: Someone fords a channel heading west, after a new mountain range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going west' turns A DAVE into EVADA, which follows N. 'Ford' looks like crossing water; it is the car maker.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sierra Nevada is a mountain range in California, and another in Spain.

clue.text: Country river, Russian one

parts.note: the Ural is a Russian river, so it is one of those

explanation.surface: A river from the country: a Russian one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country' is an adjective here, as in country life.
explanation.definitionFit: Country used as an adjective means of the countryside, which is what rural means.

clue.text: Quietly put away accumulated 19 of 16

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
to put away food is to eat it

explanation.surface: Someone quietly tidies away a heap of layers.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 is LAYERS and 16 is SPHAGNUM: peat is built up from layers of dead bog moss.
explanation.definitionFit: Peat forms as layers of dead sphagnum moss build up and decay in bogs.

clue.text: Car dumps English fruit

indicators.note: dumps means throws away, so one letter is dropped from the car

parts.note: Citroen is a French car make

explanation.surface: A French car unloads English fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A citron is a large thick-skinned citrus fruit like a lemon.

clue.text: Northern city's deer dispersed in a local peak

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: in means placed within, so the scrambled letters go inside

parts.note: in Scotland a ben is a mountain, as in Ben Nevis

indicators.note: dispersed means scattered, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Deer in a northern city have scattered across a nearby mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dispersed' gives ERDE and 'in' puts it inside the peak. Ben is the Scottish word for a mountain, hence 'local' to a Scottish city.
explanation.definitionFit: Aberdeen is a city in northeast Scotland, the north of the UK.

clue.text: Enraged Indiana bank crushes strike

parts.note: IN is the postal abbreviation for Indiana

indicators.note: crushes means squeezes, so one piece is squeezed inside the other

parts.note: the Fed is the US Federal Reserve, the central bank
to lam is to strike or thrash

explanation.surface: An Indiana bank is furious as it crushes a workers' strike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strike' looks like industrial action; it is a verb meaning hit.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflamed means stirred to anger, so it is a synonym of enraged.

clue.text: Plan to get shot of rose beds

indicators.note: to get shot of is British slang for getting rid of, so letters are removed

parts.note: a stratagem is a plan or scheme
a rose is a gem cut with a flat base and facets rising to a point

explanation.surface: A gardener plans to clear the roses out of the flower beds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beds' looks like flower beds; it means rock beds.
explanation.definitionFit: In geology beds are layers of rock, the same as strata.
